notice: REQUIRES CLINICIAN REVIEW - Generic Emergency Triage Rules Config. Do NOT alter clinical threshold rules without formal medical director approval.

redFlagRules.name: Unresponsive or Low GCS (< 13)
redFlagRules.description: Patient is unresponsive, unarousable, or has Glasgow Coma Scale less than 13.

redFlagRules.name: Severe / Uncontrolled Bleeding
redFlagRules.description: Active major arterial bleeding, uncontrolled hemorrhage, or severe blood loss.

redFlagRules.name: Chest Pain with Sweating / Diaphoresis
redFlagRules.description: Acute retrosternal chest pain accompanied by cold sweating, clamminess, or radiation.

redFlagRules.name: Stroke Sign: Facial Droop
redFlagRules.description: Sudden facial asymmetry or mouth drooping (FAST rule).

redFlagRules.name: Stroke Sign: Arm / Leg Weakness
redFlagRules.description: Sudden arm drift or unilateral extremity weakness (FAST rule).

redFlagRules.name: Stroke Sign: Speech Difficulty
redFlagRules.description: Sudden speech slurring, dysphasia, or inability to speak (FAST rule).

redFlagRules.name: Major Trauma Mechanism
redFlagRules.description: High-speed road traffic accident, fall from height (> 10 feet), penetrating trauma, or crush injury.

redFlagRules.name: Severe Respiratory Distress (SpO2 < 90%)
redFlagRules.description: Oxygen saturation below 90% or severe respiratory effort.
